title: Press to Gather - Configurable
author: Tic0311 and CamilleBC
summary: Hold your chosen controller button or press O to gather nearby resources. Adjustable 10?200 m range (20 m default), 14 button choices, and optional rare-plant gathering. Purple Epic and Unique plants are left for you to discover by default.
